from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """Captures the citation relationships found within a single provided paper."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers (known from the document summaries) that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
